_method: ROOT stream: token = consonantal root; words with no root (particles, pronouns) are skipped, so a root sequence may span them. Then every run of 3/4/5 consecutive tokens occurring in 2+ places corpus-wide, with all verse locations. Purely mechanical counting from the bundled Leeds morphology — recurrence is recorded, not interpreted; whether a recurring phrase is a "formula" in the oral-formulaic sense is a scholarly judgment this site does not make (see Bannister 2014 for that literature).
